jobs.description: Whether each cadastral edition the source contract holds is all there (root ADR-0291 §2, ADR-0379, ADR-0380): source measured and not re-uploaded, Silver within the row-loss bound of the served edition, rehearsal Gold and bake passed. Reads only Trino's partition metadata of silver.parcel_boundaries, the edition collection's newest provider inventory and the tile bake journal, judges only the editions whose inputs moved since the last run, and writes the report foundation-api serves to the operator console.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 지적 판 준비 판정
assets.description: 지적 판마다 원천·Silver·리허설이 다 있는지 판정하고, 준비된 판만 서빙판으로 승격할 수 있게 한다(루트 ADR-0379, ADR-0380). 더니어 「지적 판」 탭이 보인다.

dependencies.description: 판마다 행 수를 표의 파티션 메타데이터로만 잰다(데이터 파일을 읽지 않는다). 입력이 바뀐 판만 다시 판정한다.
